files.common.css:
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;font:14px sans-serif;background:var(--bg,#f6ecd9);color:var(--ink,#28231b)}#stage{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none}canvas{display:block}#menu{position:absolute;right:10px;top:10px;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);font-size:22px;z-index:4;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}body.awake #menu,#menu:focus{opacity:1}#panel{position:absolute;inset:72px 16px 16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:18px;z-index:5;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0002;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}#panel[hidden]{display:none}#panel header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:18px}#panel .row{display:flex;gap:8px}#panel button,#panel select{height:44px;min-width:0;flex:1;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;font:14px sans-serif}#panel header button{flex:0 0 44px}#panel p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}#hint{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:16px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s;z-index:3}body.intro #hint{opacity:1}#error{position:absolute;inset:20px;display:none;background:var(--card);padding:20px;z-index:10}#status{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}

#panel{inset:8px;padding:12px;gap:6px;overflow:auto}#panel header{font-size:16px;min-height:44px}#panel .row{flex-shrink:0}#panel p{line-height:1.3}#menu{opacity:1}

colors=['#96efcf','#ffcf86','#c7b9ff'];function rounded(x,y,w,h,r){if(w<=0||h<=0)return; r=Math.max(0,Math.min(r,w/2,h/2));g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x+r,y);g.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);g.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);g.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);g.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);g.closePath();g.fill()}let imports={env:{clear(){g.fillStyle='#071216';g.fillRect(-20,-13,200,126);frames++},rect(x,y,w,h,r,c){g.fillStyle=c?ink:'#071216';rounded(x,y,w,h,r)},triangle(x,y,x2,y2,x3,y3,c){g.fillStyle=c?ink:'#071216';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,y);g.lineTo(x2,y2);g.lineTo(x3,y3);g.fill()},rand(n){return n>0?Math.floor(Math.random()*n):0}}};let bytes=await(await fetch('eyes.wasm')).arrayBuffer(),m=(await state(){return current},setState:setMood};let touched=0;canvas.onpointermove=e=>{let r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();m.gaze(Math.max(0,Math.min(1000,(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*1000)),Math.max(0,Math.min(1000,(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*1000)));lastMove=performance.now();if(current==='tired'&&auto)setMood('default')};canvas.onclick=()=>{setMood('happy');m.action(1);touched=performance.now();};document.getElementById('mood').onchange=e=>{auto=false;document.getElementById('auto').textContent='自动情绪：关';setMood(e.target.value)};document.getElementById('laugh').onclick=()=>{setMood('happy');m.action(1)};document.getElementById('confused').onclick=()=>m.action(2);document.getElementById('sweat').onclick=()=>{let e=document.getElementById('sweat');e.dataset.on=e.dataset.on==='1'?'0':'1';m.sweat(+e.dataset.on)};document.getElementById('color').onchange=e=>ink=colors[+e.target.value];document.getElementById('auto').onclick=e=>{auto=!auto;e.target.textContent='自动情绪：'+(auto?'开':'关');if(auto)setMood('default')};function frame(t){if(t-lastMove>3000)m.idle(1);if(auto){if(touched&&t-touched>3500){touched=0;setMood('default')}if(t-lastMove>25000&&!touched&&current!=='tired')setMood('tired')}m.tick(t|0);AtomSceneSession.frame(frame)}AtomSceneSession.frame(frame);faceReady();}catch(e){faceFail(e)}})();
files.common.js: (function(){if(window.AtomApp)AtomApp.deferReady();let timer,introTimer;AtomSceneSession.onStop(()=>{clearTimeout(timer);clearTimeout(introTimer)});function wake(){document.body.classList.add('awake');clearTimeout(timer);timer=setTimeout(()=>document.body.classList.remove('awake'),2200)}let panel=document.getElementById('panel');panel.setAttribute('role','dialog');panel.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');panel.setAttribute('aria-label','眼睛设置');if(window.AtomApp)AtomApp.navigation.setBackHandler(()=>{if(!panel.hidden){panel.hidden=true;if(window.AtomInput)AtomInput.focus(document.getElementById('menu'))}else AtomApp.home()});document.getElementById('menu').onclick=()=>{panel.hidden=!panel.hidden;wake()};document.getElementById('close').onclick=()=>panel.hidden=true;document.addEventListener('pointermove',wake,{passive:true});document.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>{e.preventDefault();panel.hidden=!panel.hidden;wake()});document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Tab')wake()});window.addEventListener('error',e=>{let el=document.getElementById('error');el.style.display='block';el.textContent='动画遇到问题：'+e.message});window.faceReady=()=>{if(window.AtomApp)AtomApp.ready();document.getElementById('status').textContent='本地动画 · 点击右上角或右键调整'};window.faceFail=e=>{if(window.AtomApp)window.dispatchEvent(new ErrorEvent('error',{message:'Face initialization failed'}));let el=document.getElementById('error');el.style.display='block';el.textContent='动画未能启动：'+e.message};document.body.classList.add('intro');wake();introTimer=setTimeout(()=>document.body.classList.remove('intro'),5500);})();
